mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates aggressive monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.5pp over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) by >1.5% from 3-month averages indicate broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >1.5% from 3-month averages, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month industrial production decline exceeding 2% signals supply chain disruption, compressing corporate margins and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines by >2% from 3-month prior average, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained employment growth above 140,000 thousand persons per month indicates robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 140,000 thousand, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent unemployment rate increases and employment declines exceeding 1% from 3-month averages signal severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer confidence and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls by >1% from 3-month averages, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in residential construction (HOUST) exceeding 2% from 3-month prior averages signals strengthening demand in housing and consumer goods, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST rebounds by >2% from 3-month prior average, or Rank IC < 0.03.
